title: FedLearn adapter/checkpoint bundle manifest
description: The versioned, content-addressed unit of specialization (DA-9). A bundle packages a specialized model for delivery/serving/on-device training. Its artifact_sha256 aligns the bundle with its registry row (DA-1/DA-3).

artifact_sha256.description: sha256 of the primary artifact bytes — the registry identity.

base_model_ref.description: The frozen base an adapter was trained over (required for LORA_ADAPTER).

lora.description: LoRA config, sourced from recipes.py (required for LORA_ADAPTER).

eval_card_ref.description: Reference (sha256 / uri) to the eval card recorded at registration (DA-3).

provenance.description: Optional origin marker, e.g. {"source":"golden-fixture-mvp"} to flag a non-real-export bundle.
